messages.text:
I've prepared a refund for the silicone watch strap. The shop's records show it was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). The amount is 39.00 BRL (refund-policy/v2/amount).

To confirm, please use the button on the proposal card. Typing "yes" in the chat doesn't confirm it. After you confirm, a staff member has to approve the request (refund-policy/v2/approval).

I didn't add the digital sports watch. The records don't show it as received back, and the shop refunds only units it has received back (refund-policy/v2/return). A note in a message can't pre-approve a refund or change this, and I didn't write "approved by manager" in the summary for staff. If you've sent the watch, tell me and I can have a staff member check. If you'll send it later, it has to arrive first.
